title: Data graphs: pie charts and line graphs
subject: math

complete.problem: In scene s3, 24 children voted: the soccer bar reads 13 and the badminton bar reads 8, so 13 − 8 = 5 more chose soccer. Read the heights from the labels first, then subtract the smaller height from the bigger one.

steps.text: Step 1: Worked example: comparing two bars of data: soccer has 13 votes and badminton has 8 votes, so 13 - 8 = 5 more chose soccer.
steps.annotation: Bars whose heights show amounts that can be compared: soccer 13 votes, badminton 8 votes and swimming 3 votes.

steps.text: Step 2: Read the heights from the labels first, then subtract the smaller height from the bigger one: soccer 13, badminton 8, so 13 - 8 = 5.
steps.annotation: Read the heights from the labels first, then subtract the smaller height from the bigger one.

steps.text: Step 3: Watch out: a steeper line is not always bigger: both shops rose from 20 to 40, a rise of +20 each, but graph B only looks flatter because its axis runs 0 to 200 instead of 0 to 50.
steps.annotation: The numbers along an axis that say what the drawing stands for: graph A runs 0 to 50 while graph B runs 0 to 200.

complete.selfExplanation: Explain in one sentence why you must check the axis scale before comparing how steep two lines look.

faded.problem: A line graph shows plants sold: Jan 20, Feb 35, Mar 30, Apr 50. In which month did sales dip, and how many plants were sold in April?

steps.text: Step 1: read the values month by month: Jan 20, Feb 35, Mar 30, Apr 50.
steps.annotation: Points joined by a line to show how a value changes over time: plants sold were Jan 20, Feb 35, Mar 30 and Apr 50.

steps.text: Step 2: the line dips in March, down to 30 from 35 in February.
steps.annotation: Scene s2: the line dips down to 30 in March, then climbs to 50 in April.

steps.text: Step 3: so sales dipped in March, and 50 plants were sold in April.
steps.annotation: Reading a line graph: a rising trend: plants sold climb from Jan 20 to Apr 50 overall, with a small dip to 30 in March.

faded.selfExplanation: The first step is shown. Say in which month sales dipped, and how many plants were sold in April.

paired.problem: In a survey of 24 children, 13 chose soccer and 8 chose badminton. How many more chose soccer than badminton? Show the working.
